messages:
sam: Observing a small uptick in 5xx and p99 for payments-wave canary at 4% in eu-west-1. Can we pause the percent bump?

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started: payments-wave v3.4.0 -> 4% eu-west-1 at 1756804319. Health: degraded, errors: 0.6% (baseline 0.05%), p99 +180ms.

ops-lee: Can someone grab the quick grafana snapshot?

sam: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/payments-canary — p95=240ms, p99=620ms, errors concentrated on tokenizer shard 2.

ana: If tokenizer shard 2 is acting up, recommend HOLD and pin routing back to v3.3.9 for eu-west-1. That should stop exposure while we triage.

cheng: Agree. Also propose enabling extra request logging for that shard and throttling prefetch.

ops-lee: Command I'd run to pin: ```redwood routing override --svc payments-wave --region eu-west-1 --target v3.3.9 --note "hold canary due to shard2 p99 spike"```

sam: I approve. Ana, can you write a short rollback threshold so ops has direction?

ana: Rollback thresholds: sustained errors > 1.2% for 5m OR p99 > 800ms for 10m -> escalate to full rollback (set global stable to v3.3.9 and cancel other region canaries).

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing override ticket #ROUTE-5102 created by ops-lee. Pending exec.

ops-lee: Executing routing override now. Will report back.

(20s)
ops-lee: Done. eu-west-1 pinned to v3.3.9. Verifying traffic shift... traffic on stable nodes at 98% now. p99 back to baseline in ~30s. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks. Leaving canary at 4% but effectively drained. Hold any percent bumps or cross-region rollouts.

cheng: I'll add diagnostics to the issue and assign to infra/serving for a deep dive on tokenizer shard 2.

ana: Updating release notes: note that v3.4.0 rollout paused in eu-west-1 pending RCA and routing pin. Will append later once we have updates.

sam: Good. Closing thread for now; reopen if we need to escalate to rollback.
